findings.message: The preamble contains an unmarked checkable assertion about `docstube help`.
findings.rationale: The sentence says, “Run `docstube help` when you want the same command list printed by the executable.” That asserts `docstube help` prints the same command list as `main.subCommands`, but only the preceding `main.subCommands` statement is inside a <Claim> marker.

findings.message: The page spends reference space on commands outside the stated brief while the brief’s command set is narrower.
findings.rationale: The brief names wizard, generate, refine, audit, answer, status, preview, doctor, and version. The page also documents `validate`, `check`, `plugin`, `upgrade`, and `help`; for example, the `docstube plugin` section describes scaffolding and managing plugins even though plugins are not part of the requested command set.
